verdict.rationale: Hyatt's adjacent dining is materially useful after the 6:40 p.m. Sunday arrival and 8:10 p.m. Monday reception, supporting A. Hampton is cheaper and has the shorter walk while retaining breakfast, supporting B. The meeting hotel can reasonably be preferred for maximum event convenience despite its breakfast and parking drawbacks, supporting D. Because the exact session locations are not given and the alternatives are cancellable, C is also a defensible conservative summary. Choosing among these requires an unstated weighting of dining convenience, price, walking, and on-site access.
